title: MiniMax H3 Max Styles VHS
description: Generates 768p VHS-style video with audio from text prompts or an optional first-frame image. Supports 5–15 second clips and adjustable tape damage, from subtle analog noise to strong tracking distortion.

pricing.text: Billing is calculated per second of video generated. Video at 768p costs $0.08 per second, with audio included. A 5-second video costs $0.40, and a 15-second video costs $1.20.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Describe the scene, action, camera and sound. VHS style and tape damage are applied automatically.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: Optional first-frame image. Use a 4:3 image for the classic VHS frame; the image's aspect ratio determines the output canvas.

inputs.name: damage_level
inputs.tooltip: Tape wear: light adds subtle analog noise, medium adds visible damage, and heavy adds strong tracking errors and distortion.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: Video aspect ratio for text-only generation. Ignored when image_url is provided.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed. Omit to choose one automatically. -1 leaves it to the model.
